english: Show Read Receipts and Typing Indicator controls on your contact info page in order to directly enable/disable it for that contact.
zh_hans: 在联系人信息页中显示“已读回执”和“正在输入”控制项，以便直接为该联系人启用或禁用。

english: Hide the blue dot badge on the status tab when a new status is available
zh_hans: 当有新状态时，隐藏状态标签上的蓝点徽标。

english: The selected file is not a valid PLIST file
zh_hans: 所选文件不是有效的 PLIST 文件。

english: Replace chat textfield keyboard return key with send button.
zh_hans: 将聊天输入框键盘上的回车键替换为发送按钮。
绝不向以下对象发送已读回执...

english: Disable saving sent media taken by WhatsApp built-in camera into your device Photos app.
zh_hans: 禁止将通过 WhatsApp 内置相机拍摄并发送的媒体保存到系统相册。

english:
Replace all WhatsApp notifications content with a specific message to protect your privacy.

You can use the original notification by using:
%[title] to get the notification title
%[message] to get the notification message
zh_hans:
用自定义消息替换所有 WhatsApp 通知内容，以保护你的隐私。

你也可以通过以下占位符使用原始通知内容：
%[title] 表示通知标题
%[message] 表示通知内容

english: Settings will be exported in a PLIST file
zh_hans: 设置将导出为 PLIST 文件。

english: Add export button to audio messages context menu
zh_hans: 在音频消息的上下文菜单中新增导出按钮。

english:
The chat is locked in archive.
Would you like to unlock the chat from archive and unarchive it?
zh_hans:
此聊天已锁定在归档中。
是否要将其从归档中解锁并取消归档？

english: Show a confirmation alert before sending a sticker
zh_hans: 发送贴纸前显示确认弹窗。

english: Replaced with contact profile name or group subject
zh_hans: 替换为联系人昵称或群组标题。

english: Hide the status bar inside WhatsApp.
zh_hans: 隐藏 WhatsApp 内的状态栏。

english: Add a button on bottom right of statuses in order to download it.
zh_hans: 在状态页面右下角添加一个下载按钮。

english: A button will be added in the chat actions to manually send read receipts, it will show only when the last message is not marked as read
zh_hans: 会在聊天操作中新增一个按钮，用于手动发送已读回执。仅当最后一条消息未标记为已读时才显示。

english: Tapping new chat button will show an alert with the option to enter a phone number to message on WhatsApp without creating a contact for it.
zh_hans: 点击新建聊天按钮后，会弹出输入框，可直接输入带国家区号的手机号发起 WhatsApp 聊天，而无需先创建联系人。

english: Adds a clear button in chats list edit menu to clear chats
zh_hans: 在聊天列表编辑菜单中新增一个清空按钮，用于清空聊天。

english: Only PLIST files can be imported
zh_hans: 只能导入 PLIST 文件。

english: Your contacts will not know that you have muted the microphone during a call.
zh_hans: 对方不会知道你在通话中关闭了麦克风。

english: Show keyboard directly after you enter a chat
zh_hans: 进入聊天后直接显示键盘。

english: This will replace your current settings, you can't undo this action
zh_hans: 这将替换你当前的设置，且无法撤销此操作。

english: Clear all chats content and media including archived chats
zh_hans: 清空所有聊天内容和媒体，包括归档聊天。

english: Your contacts will not see you as typing
zh_hans: 你的联系人将看不到你正在输入。

english: If you freeze your last seen, you will not be able to view your contacts' last seen or online status because WhatsApp server requires a user to be online when requesting a last seen and freezing your last seen stops sending your online status to the server.
zh_hans: 如果你冻结了最后上线时间，你将无法查看联系人的最后上线或在线状态，因为 WhatsApp 服务器在请求最后上线时要求用户处于在线状态，而冻结最后上线会停止向服务器发送你的在线状态。

english: Disable converting single emoji message into a larger emoji.
zh_hans: 禁止将单个表情消息显示为大号表情。

english: Enter name of the WiFi network on which you wish to bypass protection when you are connected to it.
zh_hans: 输入一个 Wi-Fi 网络名称，当你连接到该网络时将绕过保护。

english: Disable iOS 11+ large titles on WhatsApp's tab bars' view controllers
zh_hans: 禁用 WhatsApp 标签页控制器上的 iOS 11+ 大标题。

english: Your contacts will not see you as recording
zh_hans: 你的联系人将看不到你正在录音。
向以下对象发起视频通话
除以下外的所有联系人

english: Stop WhatsApp from continously playing the next audio message automatically
zh_hans: 阻止 WhatsApp 自动连续播放下一条语音消息。

english: Enter contact number by adding country code followed by the phone number without any additional symbols
zh_hans: 请输入联系人号码：先输入国家区号，再输入电话号码，不要包含任何其他符号。

english:
This option will keep an empty audio file playing in background so that WhatsApp can stay active and receive notifications.
This method can sometime cause issues when recording a voice message or calling someone on WhatsApp. This issue can be fixed by restarting WhatsApp.
zh_hans:
此选项会让一个空的音频文件在后台持续播放，以便 WhatsApp 保持活跃并接收通知。
这种方法有时会在录制语音消息或拨打 WhatsApp 通话时造成问题。重启 WhatsApp 可解决此问题。

english: This option will activate location updates in background to keep WhatsApp active.
zh_hans: 此选项会在后台启用位置更新，以保持 WhatsApp 活跃。

english: Show a notification when the message is being sent to the schedule's recipients.
zh_hans: 当消息开始向定时任务接收者发送时显示通知。

english: Mute WhatsApp sound of sent/received messages and/or mute keyboard clicks.
zh_hans: 静音 WhatsApp 发送/接收消息的声音，并/或静音键盘点击声。

english: Display the number of messages for each member in the group page.
zh_hans: 在群组页面显示每位成员的消息数量。

english: View all your contacts statuses inside bar on top of the chats list
zh_hans: 在聊天列表顶部的状态栏中查看所有联系人的状态。

english: Get a confirmation alert when you tap voice or video call buttons, you can also choose between a WhatsApp call or a normal carrier call.
zh_hans: 点按语音或视频通话按钮时显示确认弹窗，你也可以选择发起 WhatsApp 通话或普通运营商通话。

english: This will create an archive of all your uploaded statuses with viewers. You can access archive from a button on top of updates tab.
zh_hans: 为你发布过的所有状态及其查看者创建归档。你可以通过更新标签页顶部的按钮访问归档。

english: Disable auto marking your contacts status as viewed and manually send viewed receipts using Watusi button. Statuses marked as viewed will not show the force mark button.
zh_hans: 禁止自动将联系人的状态标记为已查看，并通过 Watusi 按钮手动发送已查看回执。已标记为已查看的状态将不再显示强制标记按钮。

english: Adds a More button in the chats list toolbar for more actions to the list
zh_hans: 在聊天列表工具栏中新增“更多”按钮，以便对列表执行更多操作。

english: Clear selected chats content and media
zh_hans: 清空所选聊天中的内容和媒体。

english: This issue might be from "Disable Delivery Receipts" feature, WhatsApp server will stop receving/sending your new messages if you have a lot of pending messages on server waiting to be marked as delivered. It is not possible to fix this since its server-sided.
zh_hans: 此问题可能由“禁用送达回执”功能引起。如果服务器上有大量等待标记为已送达的待处理消息，WhatsApp 服务器会停止接收/发送你的新消息。由于这是服务端问题，无法修复。

english: Watusi's icon next to revoked messages
zh_hans: 已撤回消息旁 Watusi 图标的颜色。
#name 于 #date 删除了这条消息
强制发送语音已读回执

english: Hide frequently contacted section from chat picker list
zh_hans: 从聊天选择器列表中隐藏“常用联系人”分区。
以文档形式发送照片库内容

english: Add new button in Group/Broadcast picker to select/deselect all contacts. This will also bypass the 256 contacts limit. NOTE: it might not be possible to add more than 256 members into a group on server but you can try.
zh_hans: 在群组/广播选择器中新增全选/取消全选按钮。这也会绕过 256 个联系人的限制。注意：服务端可能仍无法向群组添加超过 256 名成员，但你可以尝试。

english:
Select contacts you wish to exclude from the list of your contacts sent to WhatsApp server. Contacts that are not sent to server will not be able to view your picture/status/lastseen only if you set WhatsApp privacy to 'My contacts'.

NOTE:
1) You'll not be able to edit/delete your blacklisted contacts if you have this feature enabled.
2)Your blocked contacts' profile picture thumbnails will not change until you open their picture and load the new one. 
3) You will not receive status media from your blacklisted contacts. 
4) If you have 'Stalky' tweak installed, you will not receive stalky updates for blacklisted contacts.
zh_hans:
选择你希望从发送到 WhatsApp 服务器的联系人列表中排除的联系人。未发送到服务器的联系人将无法查看你的头像/状态/最后上线，但前提是你已将 WhatsApp 隐私设置为“我的联系人”。

注意：
1) 启用此功能后，你将无法编辑/删除已拉黑的联系人。
2) 你已屏蔽联系人的头像缩略图不会立即变化，直到你打开他们的头像并加载新图片。
3) 你将不会收到已拉黑联系人的状态媒体。
4) 如果你安装了 “Stalky” tweak，你将不会收到已拉黑联系人的 Stalky 更新。

english: Adds a new button to Share Document's sheet that allows you to share any file from your device.
zh_hans: 在“分享文档”面板中新增一个按钮，可分享设备中的任意文件。
已锁定在归档中的聊天

english: Tags will be replaced with its corresponding value
zh_hans: 标签会被替换为对应的值。

english: NOTE: Auto Reply will not work properly when WhatsApp is not open on non-jailbroken devices
zh_hans: 注意：在非越狱设备上，如果 WhatsApp 没有保持打开，自动回复将无法正常工作。

english: Increase about length from 139 to 256 characters.
zh_hans: 将简介长度从 139 个字符提升到 256 个字符。

english: Hidden chats will be hidden from the chats list and will show an empty chat when opening it from somewhere else. You can only view your hidden chats messages from this page.
zh_hans: 被隐藏的聊天将从聊天列表中消失，从其他入口打开时会显示为空聊天。你只能在此页面查看隐藏聊天中的消息。

english: Add and organize additional toggles to appear in Control Center.
zh_hans: 添加并调整要在控制中心显示的附加开关。

english: A maximum number of 6 toggles can show in your control center.
zh_hans: 控制中心最多只能显示 6 个开关。

english: Disable access to the toggles when the device is passcode locked.
zh_hans: 设备锁屏时禁止访问这些开关。

english: A respring is required to apply changes.
zh_hans: 应用更改需要执行一次注销 SpringBoard。
